claims.text: LCSTS is a dataset constructed from the Chinese microblogging website Sina Weibo for Chinese short text summarization.
The LCSTS corpus consists of over 2 million real Chinese short texts paired with author-provided short summaries.
Relevance was manually tagged for 10,666 short text and summary pairs in LCSTS.
Recurrent neural networks can be applied to generate short text summaries on the LCSTS dataset.

evidence.description: The authors state: 'we introduce a large corpus of Chinese short text summarization dataset constructed from the Chinese microblogging website Sina Weibo'
The authors state: 'This corpus consists of over 2 million real Chinese short texts with short summaries given by the author of each text.'
The authors state: 'We also manually tagged the relevance of 10,666 short summaries with their corresponding short texts.'
The authors state: 'Based on the corpus, we introduce recurrent neural network for the summary generation'

methodologies.name: Recurrent Neural Network Short Text Summarization
methodologies.description: Constructed a Chinese short text summarization dataset from Sina Weibo and trained recurrent neural networks to generate summaries.

limitations.text: Automatic text summarization research is hindered by the lack of large text summarization datasets.
